items.name: Luzern Sunset Solves 2026
items.information: ![Luzern Sunset Solves 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg3MjAzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3f1469f95a09ed6979eb78aee757aa8b02c975e8/logo_without_bg.png) [*DE*] ###Dieser Wettkampf wird für die Events 2x2x2, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx und 3x3x3 Blindfolded in zwei Gruppen durchgeführt. Du wirst in einer Gruppe antreten und in der anderen Gruppe entweder als Runner, Judge oder Scrambler mithelfen. Wenn du in einem dieser Events teilnimmst, MUSST du während der gesamten Dauer beider Gruppen anwesend sein (d.h. von 19:30 bis 21:10 Uhr), sonst darfst du nicht teilnehmen. Möchtest Du nur beim 3x3x3 (Tab "3x3x3 Dual Round" beachten) mitmachen, kannst Du natürlich vorher schon gehen. ###Bitte lies vor deiner Anmeldung unbedingt den Reiter „Special Format“. --- [*EN*] ###This competition will be run in two groups for the events 2x2x2, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx and 3x3x3 Blindfolded. You will compete in one group and help out in the other group as a runner, judge, or scrambler. If you participate in one of these events, you MUST be present for the entire duration of both groups (i.e. from 19:30 to 21:10), otherwise you cannot participate. If you only want to compete in 3x3x3 (See tab "3x3x3 Dual Round"), then obviously you may leave earlier. ###Please make sure to read the tab "Special Format" carefully before registering.

items.name: Wolfpack Wednesday NC I 2026
items.information: **This competition does NOT have the standard 3x3x3 Cube event and takes place on a Wednesday evening.** **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WolfpackWednesdayNCI2026#75024-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WolfpackWednesdayNCI2026#75028-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk4MTYxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--af0585c8fc7c8df1b310e5683b32896ba39aa835/image.png)
